method: A promotion or bonus is listed only when verified directly on a first-party bank page or official bank PDF retrieved on 2026-10-22. Where a bank publishes no savings opening bonus on its official account pages, that bank is logged explicitly below with the URL checked.

promotions.headline: $400 cash bonus + 4.25% ongoing APY on Select Savings from Barclays
promotions.requirements: Open a new Select Savings account online between October 1, 2026 and October 31, 2026 (active AARP membership required), deposit $40,000 or more within 30 calendar days, and maintain at least $40,000 for 120 consecutive calendar days. Bonus credited within ~60 days after hold completion.
promotions.eligibility: First-time Barclays Select Savings customers with an active AARP membership.

promotions.headline: +0.50% APY boost for 6 months (4.25% APY on $5,000+; 4.00% Year-1 blended APY) with code BOOST50
promotions.requirements: Open a new CIT Bank Platinum Savings account ($100 minimum opening deposit) or enroll an eligible existing account with promo code BOOST50 between September 29, 2026 and December 15, 2026. Maintains +0.50% above standard tier APY for 6 months on balances up to $9,999,999 (4.25% APY on $5,000+).
promotions.eligibility: New and qualifying existing CIT Bank Platinum Savings customers.

promotions.headline: $200 cash bonus on Barclays Tiered Savings (3.50% / 3.65% APY)
promotions.requirements: Open a new Barclays Tiered Savings account online by October 31, 2026, deposit $25,000 or more within 30 calendar days, and maintain at least $25,000 for 120 consecutive calendar days.
promotions.eligibility: New Barclays Tiered Savings customers (no AARP membership needed).

promotions.headline: $50 or $400 direct-deposit cash bonus + 1.10% APY boost for up to 6 months (4.40% APY; 4.70% w/ Plus)

tiers.requirement: $1,000.00 - $4,999.99 in qualifying direct deposits within 25 calendar days
$5,000.00 or more in qualifying direct deposits within 25 calendar days

promotions.requirements: Cash bonus: receive qualifying payroll/benefit direct deposits within a 25-day evaluation period ($1,000-$4,999.99 earns $50; $5,000+ earns $400). Rate boost: set up eligible direct deposit within 60 days of opening by 12/31/2027 to earn +1.10% boost (4.40% APY) for up to 6 months (4.70% APY on <=$20,000 individual / <=$40,000 joint with $10/mo SoFi Plus).

promotions.headline: 3.75% 3-month promotional interest rate on $25,000+ new funds (discontinued tomorrow, 2026-10-23)
promotions.requirements: Deposit $25,000+ in New-to-Citi funds into a new Citi Savings account opened on or before October 22, 2026 to earn a 3.75% promotional interest rate for 3 months (0.98%–1.05% blended Year-1 APY depending on relationship tier; reverts to 0.03%–0.12% standard rate thereafter). Official Citi Fact_Sheet.pdf states this promo is discontinued effective October 23, 2026.
promotions.eligibility: New Citi Savings accounts funded with $25,000+ in new-to-Citi money on or before 2026-10-22.

promotions.headline: $200 cash bonus for a new TD Simple or TD Signature Savings account
promotions.requirements: Open a new TD Simple Savings or TD Signature Savings account online by November 30, 2026, deposit at least $10,000 in external new money within 20 calendar days, and maintain a balance of at least $10,000 for 90 additional days.
promotions.eligibility: New personal TD savings customers residing in eligible TD footprint states who have not held a TD savings account or received a TD savings bonus in the prior 12 months.

promotions.headline: $100 or $200 cash bonus for a new Chase Savings(SM) account
promotions.requirements: Open a new Chase Savings account with the offer code, deposit qualifying new money within 30 business days of enrollment ($5,000+ for $100; $10,000+ for $200), and maintain the balance for 90 days from enrollment. Paid within 15 days after completion.
promotions.eligibility: New Chase savings customers only; one savings bonus every two years.

promotions.headline: +1.00% APY Referral Boost for 3 months (4.50% boosted APY / 3.75% Year-1 APY)
promotions.requirements: Open a Marcus Online Savings Account via a referral link or refer a new customer: both parties earn +1.00% APY on top of the 3.50% base rate for 3 months (up to 5 referrals per calendar year).
promotions.eligibility: Referred friend must be a new Marcus customer.

promotions.headline: Up to 3.50% APY with eligible U.S. Bank relationship and $25,000+ combined balances
promotions.requirements: Hold Bank Smartly Checking, Safe Debit, or Bank Smartly Visa Signature card plus $25,000+ in combined qualifying balances (1.00% below $5k; 2.00% $5k-$24,999.99).
promotions.eligibility: Owners of an eligible U.S. Bank companion product.

promotions.headline: 3.25% variable APY on Platinum Savings for new savings customers with $25,000+
promotions.requirements: Deposit and maintain $25,000+ in a new Platinum Savings account within 30 days.
promotions.eligibility: New Wells Fargo savings customers only.
